faq.q: Were any customers double-charged during the 7/13 payment outage?
faq.a: No. Failed requests errored before capture, so no double charges occurred; failed orders simply did not go through.

faq.q: Are CloudCart webhooks signed and how do I verify them?
faq.a: Yes. HMAC-SHA256 using the merchant webhook secret, delivered in the X-CloudCart-Signature header (format t=<timestamp>,v1=<hex>). Verify the digest and check the timestamp with ~5 minute tolerance to prevent replay.

A deploy (payment-service v2.14.0) introduced an N+1 query in the saved-payment-methods endpoint that exhausted the database connection pool, starving the charge path. It was resolved by rolling back to v2.13.2.

faq.q: Is a transactions CSV export available?
faq.a: Not yet; it is planned for the next sprint (date-range filter, async generation, emailed download link).
